source_calendars.title: Choose source calendars
source_calendars.description: Select the Home Assistant calendar entities to mirror into Google Calendar.

target_calendar.title: Choose target calendar
target_calendar.description: Pick which of your Google Calendars to sync events into. If your calendars couldn't be loaded, enter a calendar ID manually instead (use "primary" for your main calendar, or the calendar's address from Google Calendar settings).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Mirror to Google Calendar
reauth_confirm.description: Your Google authorization has expired or been revoked. Sign in again to keep syncing.

error.no_calendars_selected: Select at least one source calendar.

abort.already_configured: This Google Calendar is already being synced by another Calendar Mirror entry.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
abort.missing_credentials: The integration requires credentials to be set up before it can be used. Add the credentials, then try again.

init.title: Reconfigure Calendar Mirror
init.description: Change which Home Assistant calendars are mirrored and which Google Calendar they sync into.

error.no_calendars_selected: Select at least one source calendar.
error.target_already_configured: Another Calendar Mirror entry is already syncing into this calendar.

application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) for setting up a Google API OAuth client. You will need to create credentials with a **Web application** type authorized to redirect to `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth`.

To be able to configure Calendar Mirror you first need to set up access to the [Google Cloud Console]({oauth_creds_url}) and enable the Calendar API on the [consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}).
